description: Finds upcoming or recent football matches (next 21 days) by team name, accepting nicknames such as "PSG", "Man City", "Barça" or "Bayern Munich". Optionally narrow with the opponent and a date. Returns candidate matches with their match_id, to pass to get_match_probabilities. If several teams match (e.g. "Paris" = Paris FC or Paris Saint-Germain), all are returned: ask the user which one they mean.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

team.description: A team name or nickname, e.g. "PSG", "Arsenal", "Inter".

name: find_match
title: Find a match
